recipes.name: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil 30–60 sec; add chopped tomato 3–4 min.
Toss pasta with sauce and basil; finish with parmesan, salt, pepper.

recipes.name: Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Warm oil; cook onion and garlic 2–3 min.
Add black beans, cumin, salt; mash lightly.
Fill tortillas; top with tomato and lettuce.

recipes.name: Tofu Stir-Fry
instructions: Press and cube tofu; sear until golden.
Stir-fry vegetables; add garlic.
Toss with soy sauce and a little sesame oil; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Spinach Mushroom Quesadilla
instructions: Sauté onion and mushroom; add spinach until wilted.
Assemble tortilla with cheese and veg; cook both sides until melted.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
instructions: Sauté onion in oil; add garlic and ginger.
Stir in cumin and curry powder; add tomato and chickpeas.
Simmer 10–12 min; season with salt.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs; set aside.
Stir-fry veg; add cold rice and soy sauce.
Fold in eggs; season to taste.

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Boil pasta; reserve some water.
Sauté veg with garlic; toss with pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parmesan, salt, pepper.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Chickpeas
instructions: Warm olive oil; lightly sauté garlic.
Add chickpeas; season with lemon juice, salt, pepper.
Finish with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa; cool slightly.
Toss with chopped veg, olive oil, lemon, salt, pepper; add feta.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Curry
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add tomato, cauliflower, coconut milk; simmer until tender.
Season with salt.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs with chopped onion, tomato, cilantro, chili, and salt.
Cook in a little oil until set; fold and serve.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread
instructions: Top flatbread with sliced tomato and mozzarella.
Bake or pan-cook until cheese melts; finish with basil, oil, salt, pepper.

recipes.name: Potato Pea Curry
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger; add curry powder.
Add cubed potato, tomato, peas; simmer until potato is tender.
Season with salt.

recipes.name: Broccoli Pesto Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta with broccoli florets.
Toss with pesto and parmesan; season to taste.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs; set aside.
Stir-fry rice; add soy sauce and green onion.
Fold in eggs; season and serve.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dal
instructions: Rinse lentils; simmer with water until soft.
Make a tadka: sauté onion, garlic, ginger with spices; add tomato.
Stir into lentils; salt to taste.

recipes.name: Veggie Burrito Bowl
instructions: Warm beans with cumin and salt.
Assemble bowl with rice, beans, corn, lettuce, tomato, cheddar; squeeze lime.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta.
Melt butter; gently cook garlic; toss with pasta and parmesan.

recipes.name: Tofu Peanut Noodles
instructions: Whisk peanut butter with soy sauce, lime, and a splash of water.
Pan-fry tofu; cook noodles; toss everything with sauce; top with green onion.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto (Quick)
instructions: Sauté onion and mushroom in butter; add garlic.
Add rice; stir; gradually add hot stock until creamy.
Finish with parmesan; season.
